$comment: The direct host startup line, character for character in both clients. JS: formatHostLog(requested, bound, code, kind, mapping, nostr?) in src/direct/index.ts. C#: DirectLobby.FormatHostLog. Kinds use the JS names (nostr, internet, same_network, none); an absent 'nostr' means Nostr is off. Replayed by test/direct.test.ts and NostrTests.cs.

vectors.name: internet code, UPnP
vectors.line: OneLobby: direct host listening on TCP+UDP :47810; code 6B01-RGFE-P2B (Internet); port mapping UPnP

vectors.name: one port busy
vectors.line: OneLobby: direct host listening on TCP+UDP :47811 (47810 busy); code 0A00-0BSE-P3S (SameNetwork); port mapping off

vectors.name: three ports busy, no IPv4 address, empty mapping reads off
